quotation.title: QUOTATION
quotation.defaultTerms:
1. This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date of issue.
2. Prices are subject to change without notice.
3. A deposit is required before work begins.

invoice.title: INVOICE
invoice.defaultTerms:
1. This invoice is valid and payable within 14 days from the invoice date.
2. Payment shall be made to the company account as stated.
3. Any disputes must be raised within 7 days from the invoice date.

workOrder.title: WORK ORDER
workOrder.defaultTerms:
1. Work shall be carried out according to agreed specifications.
2. Scope changes require written approval.
3. Payment within 14 days from invoice date.
